purpose: Persist the user's explicit visual-caption, explainer-diagram motion and default future-video duration preferences across sessions without relying on conversation memory.

caption_visual_style.rule: 字幕本文は話者別の淡い緑・淡いピンクを基調にし、話者バッジも同系色にする。色は薄くしても暗い縁取りと暗色半透明パネルを維持し、スマートフォン表示で読みやすくする。重要語の強調は意味のまとまりだけに限定し、普段の字幕全体を派手にしない。
caption_visual_style.readability_guard: Speaker color is an accent/border signal, not permission to reduce text/background contrast. Preserve a deterministic contrast separator such as a thin dark inner stroke or equivalent when needed for readability.

explainer_background_diagram_motion.reason: The user observed the background/explainer diagram moving up and down and explicitly requested that it be stationary.
allowed_semantic_motion: intentional camera change when specifically justified by the semantic beat

do_not_pad_with: generic history added only to increase runtime
slow narration solely to hit duration
earn_runtime_with: more primary-source-backed facts that materially explain the topic
important chronology only when it changes understanding
credible competing interpretations or uncertainty when relevant
what changes next and what remains unknown
necessary definitions and context that directly improve comprehension
future_video_duration_default.insufficient_material_rule: Do not manufacture length. Use 4-6 minutes for a focused question or 6-8 for a compact broad-release summary when those lengths fully answer the viewer's question. Use 8-12 only when source-backed mechanisms, examples, impact, or limitations make the extra depth useful. Never pad to meet a target.

runtime_adaptation.broad_release_rule: Select three to five major changes, group related announcements, explain each in plain Japanese with one practical example and the material access/limitation, and briefly name omitted minor items.

character_performance.latest_user_request: 表情が変わらず口も動かなかった。次回以降はキャラクター表情と発話口形を実際の出力へ反映する。
